    River Plantation

    Discover River Plantation - an established Parrish neighborhood offering spacious homes, resort-style amenities including pool, courts, kayak launch, and more.

    Single Family

    1,500 - 3,500

    $300s - $800s

    Nature-focused with river access

    About River Plantation

    River Plantation is a well-established neighborhood in Parrish with around 450 single-family residences. Homes typically range from 1,500 to nearly 3,500 sq ft, often on lakeside lots, making it a solid option for families seeking space and natural surroundings.

    Community amenities are a highlight: a clubhouse, community pool, tennis, pickleball, basketball, playground, kayak/canoe launch, and miles of nature trails weave through scenic wetlands and preserves. The HOA maintains common areas and there is no CDD fee, which helps keep ongoing costs affordable.

    With its balanced blend of amenities, outdoor access, sizeable homes, and no hidden fees, River Plantation offers great value and a relaxed Florida living experience.

    Schools

    Grade School: Annie Lucy Williams Elementary

    Middle School: Buffalo Creek Middle

    High School: Palmetto High

     Nearby Neighborhoods in Parrish

    Del Webb at Bayview (55+)

    Del Webb at Bayview gives you an incredible 55+ active adult community experience. World-class amenities here include a resort-style pool, fitness center, year-round events, tennis, pickleball, bocce ball and more.

    Windwater

    Windwater is a gated, coastal-inspired community by Mattamy Homes. This neighborhood features stunning new construction homes along with a community pool, dog park and playground.

    Canoe Creek

    Canoe Creek offers new construction by Neal Communities - where residents enjoy brand new homes and a vast array of amenities. These include a lagoon-style pool, fitness center, pickleball courts, dog parks, year-round events and more.

    Aviary at Rutland Ranch

    Aviary at Rutland Ranch blends resort-style perks like a heated pool, pickleball and walking trails with affordable new homes - making it an ideal spot for laid-back living.
